in_sanskrit.name: Jalam
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Water, Rain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jalam एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Jalam is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Jal’, which means ‘water’ or ‘rain’. This name is often associated with Lord Indra, the deity of rain and thunder. It is believed that the name Jalam carries the blessings of Lord Indra, who brings life-giving rain and prosperity.
